description: Publication-scale Experiment E1 plan aligned with Section 7.2.3 and Section 7.3 of the redesigned evaluation chapter. Each primary sweep changes one factor family while holding the others fixed.

sweeps.name: T_scale
sweeps.notes: Primary H1a sweep over the manuscript's T_s range. Every MSI descriptor, root-only lower-bound record, active anchor, and bounded hot window is physically materialized; historical payload and auxiliary stores use exact fixed-width serialization models.

sweeps.name: shard_scale
sweeps.notes: Primary N_sh sweep. Fixed-width verifier-resident structures are physically materialized; common payload, auxiliary state, and hot-state capacity are exact serialization models to avoid multi-gigabyte temporary files at 128 shards.

sweeps.name: n_standard
sweeps.notes: Primary epoch-size sweep at the exact n levels in Section 7.2.3. Auxiliary and payload bytes are deterministic serialization formulas; selected points are independently materialized in serialization_audit.

sweeps.name: n_boundary
sweeps.notes: Complete 2^d-1, 2^d, and 2^d+1 padding-boundary sweep through the manuscript's maximum standard epoch length.

sweeps.name: block_scale
sweeps.notes: Primary canonical-block-size sweep at 0.5, 2, 8, and 32 KiB. It tests that verifier-resident historical descriptors are insensitive to payload size.

sweeps.name: hot_window
sweeps.notes: Primary W sweep at the exact 1, 10, and 100 epoch levels. It separates bounded hot-state growth from historical MSI growth.

sweeps.name: layout_codec
sweeps.notes: Three-seed metadata-binding and exact serialized-size audit for two layouts and two codec versions. Compression is not treated as a competing scheme.

sweeps.name: serialization_audit
sweeps.notes: Independent physical serialization audit, including the first post-512 padding step. It verifies that exact byte models match files written by the reference encoder.
